description: Source code for utility functions related to WAN management, including IP path retrieval, interface prefix management, and route configuration, with extensive licensing and debug macros.

methods.name: ipversion_valid
methods.description: Checks if the given IP version is valid (IPv4 or IPv6, not invalid).

methods.name: get_ipversion
methods.description: Determines the IP version (IPv4 or IPv6) based on mode control flags.

methods.name: ip_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for IP-related components.

methods.name: dhcpv4_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for DHCPv4 components.

methods.name: dhcpv6_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for DHCPv6 components.

methods.name: ppp_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for PPP components.

methods.name: routing_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for routing components.

methods.name: dns_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for DNS components.

methods.name: ethernet_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for Ethernet components.

methods.name: logical_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for logical interface components.

methods.name: neighbor_discovery_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for Neighbor Discovery components.

methods.name: dslite_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for DSLite components.

methods.name: pcp_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for PCP components.

methods.name: xpon_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for XPON components.

methods.name: cellular_get_context
methods.description: Retrieves the context handle for Cellular components.

methods.name: get_ip_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the IP configuration based on parameters and IP version.

methods.name: get_ppp_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the PPP configuration based on parameters and IP version.

methods.name: get_dhcp_path
methods.description: Returns the DHCP path for DHCPv4 or DHCPv6, with string replacement for client paths.

methods.name: get_nd_path
methods.description: Returns the Neighbor Discovery path, with fallback to default if not set.

methods.name: get_dslite_path
methods.description: Returns the DSLite path, with fallback to default if not set.

methods.name: get_pcp_path
methods.description: Returns the PCP path, with fallback to default if not set.

methods.name: get_bridge_path
methods.description: Returns the bridge reference path, if set.

methods.name: get_default_router_path
methods.description: Returns the default router reference path, if set.

methods.name: ipv6_prefix_lan_toggle
methods.description: Enables or disables IPv6 prefix on a LAN interface.

methods.name: ipv6_addr_toggle
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific IPv6 address on an interface.

methods.name: ipv6_prefix_toggle
methods.description: Enables or disables an IPv6 prefix configuration on an interface.

methods.name: ipv4_addr_toggle
methods.description: Enables or disables an IPv4 address on an interface.

methods.name: get_prefixes_from_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves IPv6 prefixes from a list of interfaces.

methods.name: convert_prefixes_data
methods.description: Converts prefix data from old to new reference paths for interfaces.

methods.name: ip_parent_prefix_toggle
methods.description: Switches parent prefix paths for IPv6 interfaces.

methods.name: routing_default_route_set_origin
methods.description: Sets the origin for a default route.

methods.name: routing_default_ipv6_route_mod_inst
methods.description: Adds or removes IPv6 forwarding instances in routing.

methods.name: add_str_to_list
methods.description: Adds a string to a list if not already present.

methods.name: remove_str_from_list
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a string from a list.

methods.name: create_logical_path
methods.description: Creates a path string for a logical interface.

methods.name: object_const_string
methods.description: Retrieves a constant string value from an object parameter.

methods.name: trim_final_dot
methods.description: Removes trailing dot from a path string, returns a new allocated string.

methods.name: get_prefixed_parameter_name
methods.description: Returns a parameter name with global vendor prefix if set.
